title: Show HN: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop #Shorts
description:
AI coding agents are powerful but they execute real commands on your real machine — one hallucinated rm -rf and your day is ruined. Clawk gives each agent session its own disposable Linux VM: full access inside, zero risk outside. If you're using any agentic coding tool, this is the safety layer you should have set up yesterday.

#codingagents #devtools #AIcoding #linux #softwaredevelopment #programming #opensource #techtools #Shorts
